command:
set -eo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp LC_ALL=C
cd /tmp

echo "== restore SeSAMe's ExperimentHub cache, and verify the resource CONTENTS =="
# Extract into a directory THIS CONTAINER creates, never into /tmp itself: the tar
# carries a '.' entry, so `-C /tmp` makes tar try to chmod/utime /tmp -- which is
# sticky 1777 and owned by the INSTANCE user while this runs as the image's user, so
# it fails with EPERM and tar exits non-zero even though every file extracted. Same
# ownership trap as never-rm-a-staged-input (practices/container-path.md), reached
# through tar. -m and --no-same-* stop it restoring times/modes it cannot set.
mkdir -p /tmp/sesamehome
tar -xmf /tmp/sesame-cache.tar -C /tmp/sesamehome --no-same-owner --no-same-permissions
export HOME=/tmp/sesamehome
C=/tmp/sesamehome/.cache/R/ExperimentHub
test -d "$C" || { echo "cache dir missing after untar"; ls -R /tmp/sesamehome | head; exit 1; }
# The pin is on content: BiocFileCache gives each blob a random prefix and the
# sqlite files carry timestamps, so names and the tar sum are not reproducible but
# the downloaded resources are immutable. Require the hash SET to match.
cat > /tmp/want.txt <<'EOF'
73578ce17c439acc8e1443f9a6c55c3f02fdcc18cdff287b7b93f74cb86c835e
7f361fdce9de733ab7b59461d89d950bcca3bf363cea999176f281ab7df2d982
99300ba1d45aec5d5fdcdb12b61923f7313b1600c4ec9c8b9ca573d09bfc1655
b4eb0da4ef492655c2fe18b45fa65e969967c9f4a0c2149a5fae9241b510c7b2
EOF
( cd "$C" && for x in $(ls | grep -vE 'sqlite|LOCK'); do sha256sum "$x" | cut -d' ' -f1; done ) | sort > /tmp/got.txt
sort -o /tmp/want.txt /tmp/want.txt
diff /tmp/want.txt /tmp/got.txt || { echo 'sesameData cache contents do not match the pins'; exit 1; }
echo "  OK: $(wc -l < /tmp/got.txt | tr -d ' ') blobs match their pinned sha256"

echo "== the IDATs minfi exported, same bytes it analysed =="
mkdir -p /tmp/idats
tar -xmf /tmp/idats.tar -C /tmp/idats --no-same-owner --no-same-permissions
find /tmp/idats -iname '*.idat' | wc -l

cat > cmp.R <<'REOF'
suppressMessages(library(sesame))
f <- function(k, v) cat(sprintf("%-30s %s\n", k, v))
fail <- character(0)
ck <- function(k, ok, v) { f(k, v); if (!ok) fail <<- c(fail, k) }
ob <- function(k, v) cat(sprintf("%-30s %s   [observation]\n", k, v))

f("sesame_version",     as.character(packageVersion("sesame")))
f("sesameData_version", as.character(packageVersion("sesameData")))

p <- searchIDATprefixes("/tmp/idats")
ck("idat_prefixes", length(p) == 6, sprintf("%d  want exactly 6", length(p)))

S <- openSesame(p); colnames(S) <- basename(colnames(S))
ck("sesame_ran_offline", all(dim(S) > 0),
   sprintf("%d x %d betas, %d non-NA  (no network on this box)", nrow(S), ncol(S), sum(!is.na(S))))
M <- as.matrix(read.delim("/tmp/minfi-betas.tsv.gz", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE))
ck("minfi_betas_read", nrow(M) == 485512 && ncol(M) == 6,
   sprintf("%d x %d  want 485512 x 6", nrow(M), ncol(M)))

shared <- intersect(rownames(M), rownames(S))
Ms <- M[shared, ]; Ss <- S[shared, colnames(Ms)]
keep <- complete.cases(Ms) & complete.cases(Ss)
Ms <- Ms[keep, ]; Ss <- Ss[keep, ]
ob("shared_probes", sprintf("%d of %d minfi / %d sesame", length(shared), nrow(M), nrow(S)))
ob("probes_both_retain", sprintf("%d  (sesame masks the rest)", nrow(Ms)))

# Different normalisation makes RAW beta values incomparable, so compare by RANK; and make
# the claim a MATCHING rather than a correlation threshold, so there is nothing to tune.
# Probes are ranked by variance in minfi's matrix alone -- not by the comparison's own
# outcome -- and the restriction is there because between-sample methylation differences
# live in the variable probes; over all of them the margin is only 0.009, which is a thin
# check pretending to be a strong one.
match_at <- function(Ma, Sa) {
  C <- cor(Ma, Sa, method = "spearman")
  best <- apply(C, 2, function(x) rownames(C)[which.max(x)])
  offmax <- sapply(seq_len(ncol(C)), function(j) max(C[-j, j]))
  list(n = sum(best == colnames(C)), tot = ncol(C),
       mind = min(diag(C)), maxoff = max(offmax))
}
v <- apply(Ms, 1, var)
ladder <- c(50000, 20000, 5000, 1000)
for (n in ladder) {
  idx <- head(order(v, decreasing = TRUE), n)
  r <- match_at(Ms[idx, ], Ss[idx, ])
  ob(sprintf("  match_top%d", n),
     sprintf("%d/%d  min diag %.5f  max off %.5f  margin %.5f", r$n, r$tot, r$mind, r$maxoff, r$mind - r$maxoff))
}
ra <- match_at(Ms, Ss)
ob("  match_all_probes", sprintf("%d/%d  margin %.5f  (thin -- why the restriction exists)",
   ra$n, ra$tot, ra$mind - ra$maxoff))

idx <- head(order(v, decreasing = TRUE), 5000)
r <- match_at(Ms[idx, ], Ss[idx, ])
# The assertion: two independent preprocessing pipelines agree about WHICH SAMPLE IS WHICH,
# for all six, with the nearest rival a clear distance back. 6 correct of 36 ordered pairs.
ck("pipelines_agree_on_identity", r$n == r$tot,
   sprintf("%d/%d samples' best rank-match is the same sample (top 5000 probes)", r$n, r$tot))
ck("identity_margin_not_marginal", (r$mind - r$maxoff) > 0.05,
   sprintf("min diag %.5f vs max off-diag %.5f, margin %.5f  want > 0.05", r$mind, r$maxoff, r$mind - r$maxoff))

if (length(fail)) { cat("FAILED: ", paste(fail, collapse = ", "), "\n"); quit(status = 1) }
REOF
Rscript cmp.R > smoke-check.txt 2>&1 || { cat smoke-check.txt; exit 1; }
cat smoke-check.txt
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
